<infobox theme="Medal">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="awarded by"><label>Awarded by</label></data>
        <data source="eligibility"><label>Eligibility requirements</label></data>	
        <data source="recipients"><label>Recipients</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Precedence</header>
        <data source="prerequisites"><label>Prerequisites</label></data>			
        <data source="upgrades"><label>Upgrades</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="first awarded"><label>First awarded</label></data>
        <data source="last awarded"><label>Last awarded</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Medal|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.

{{Medal

|name=
|awarded by=
|eligibility=
|recipients=
|prerequisites=
|upgrades=
|first awarded=
|last awarded=}}
</nowiki></pre>
